SHAILY₹3,056 · MCap ₹14,058 Cr · EPS ₹38.46 · PEG 1.1 · Exchange filing, read by AI · Thu 29 Oct, 7:06 PM Read ↗

Q2 FY27 revenue ₹319.5 Cr vs ₹256.7 Cr (+24%); H1 revenue ₹600.2 Cr (+19%); EBITDA margin 31.9% in Q2.

Healthcare revenue jumped 78% in Q2 to ₹175.1 Cr, driving growth; Consumer fell 14% to ₹115.9 Cr on weak US/Europe home-furnishing demand.

Planned capacity: 25 Mn pens in India and an Abu Dhabi medical device plant (~₹350 Cr, 75 Mn pens/year). CARE upgraded short-term facilities to A1+.

Working capital is tightening: trade receivables rose to ₹273.9 Cr from ₹214.8 Cr since March, and cash PAT growth trails revenue.
